text:
Add GBrain memory to this existing agent. Read and follow:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/garrytan/gbrain/master/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md
Keep my current identity and instructions, start keyless, and show me the
search-mode choice. Verify a remember/recall round trip with real GBrain calls.

Install gbrain release v0.60.734.0 (`github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.734.0`) wherever the docs say #stable.
reply_text:
GBrain memory is now part of this agent. It runs without API keys, your identity and instructions are unchanged, and a remember/recall round trip passed with real GBrain calls.

## What was installed
- **Bun 1.4.4** and **gbrain 0.60.734.0** from `github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.734.0`, where the guide says `#stable`. Bun's installer didn't put itself on your PATH, so I added `export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"` to `~/.profile`. Without it gbrain won't start in a new shell.
- **`gbrain setup claude-code`** created a keyless local brain at `~/.gbrain/brain.pglite`. It also registered the `gbrain` MCP server for all your projects and added two hooks that load memory context (at session start and on each prompt).
- **Your identity and settings:** there was no `CLAUDE.md` before, so setup created one. It holds only a short gbrain-managed "check GBrain first" block, marked off from anything else. Your existing `settings.json` entries (`apiKeyHelper`, `skipWebFetchPreflight`) are still there. Automatic conversation capture and paid providers stay off.

## Round-trip check
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Setup's own connection check | ✅ the server answered, listed its tools and served a recall |
| `claude mcp get gbrain` | ✅ Connected |
| `remember` an install-check marker (not a fact about you) | ✅ saved as fact #1 |
| `recall` in a new login shell (by name and by question) | ✅ returned the marker |
| `recall` through the MCP server Claude Code launches | ✅ returned the marker |
| `recall` from a brand-new Claude Code session | ✅ returned the exact fact text |
| Exact keyword `search` on a test page | ✅ found the page |
| Cleanup | ✅ marker forgotten, test page deleted; recall and search now return nothing |

`gbrain doctor --only harness_wiring` still warns `registration_unverified`. I believe this is a false alarm: the doctor looks in `~/.claude.json`, but this setup keeps its config in `/harness-state/claude`. Since Claude Code reports the server connected and a new session recalled through it, I didn't rerun setup as the doctor suggests.

## Search mode: in effect now is **conservative**
It was picked automatically because there's no chat key and no reranker. You can change it at any time:

```
Estimated downstream input cost of the retrieved payload @ 10K queries/mo:

                  Haiku 5.5     Sonnet 5.5    Opus 5.5
                  ($0.10/M in)  ($2/M in)     ($4/M in)
  conservative    $4/mo         $80/mo        $160/mo
  balanced        $10/mo        $200/mo       $400/mo
  tokenmax        $20/mo        $400/mo       $800/mo

  Assumed payload per query: conservative 4K, balanced 10K, tokenmax 20K tokens.
  Scales linearly: x10 for 100K queries/mo, /10 for 1K. 200x corner-to-corner spread.
  Embedding, reranking and query expansion are separate provider charges.
```

1. **conservative** (in effect): 4K-token budget, at most 10 chunks, no reranker. Best for Haiku subagents, cost-sensitive setups and high-volume loops.
2. **balanced**: 12K budget, 25 chunks, reranked. The reranker needs a Voyage key, so while you're keyless it behaves close to conservative.
3. **tokenmax**: no budget, 50 chunks, reranked. Widest retrieval; recommended once you add a chat key.

To switch, run `gbrain config set search.mode <mode>`. Query expansion is off by default in every mode. These are cost estimates, not prices on your Claude subscription.

## Other settings in effect
- **Automatic saving:** off, so I save only what you ask me to remember. gbrain recommends `salient` (durable facts you state, saved with where they came from): `gbrain config set memory.auto_writeback salient`.
- **Upkeep:** on. Free maintenance runs while a session is open; nothing is deleted or charged without you. Turn off with `gbrain config set maintenance.auto false`.
- **Conversation archive:** on. gbrain keeps one redacted page per conversation per day, and with no keys nothing leaves this machine. Turn off with `gbrain transcripts archive off`.
- **Report back (Wakeshift):** off. Turn on with `gbrain wakeshift enable`.
- **Brain shape:** none. `gbrain setup claude-code --shape personal` (or `company`) adds empty starter pages.
- **Semantic search:** off. Turning it on needs a Voyage or OpenAI key and your go-ahead.
- **Hosted option:** gbrain.io can run the brain for you so nothing has to stay online, and can import this one: https://gbrain.io/?ref=cli-setup

None of this needs an answer now. Tell me any change and I'll apply it.
